title: Designing Social Robots with Ethical, User-Adaptive Explainability in the Era of Foundation Models
reasoning: The paper identifies and analyzes ethical risks such as systemic bias, epistemic exclusion, and normative misalignment in foundation-model-driven social robots. It proposes four specific recommendations for ethical, user-adaptive explainability. This ethical framework and analysis constitute the paper's primary contribution, extending far beyond a brief considerations section.
